comment: Live-site E2E cases for scripts/run-pipeline-tests.ts. category: text|pdf|image|multilang|js|multi. smoke: stable subset for quick runs (npm run test:smoke). The six sites added 2026-08-05 (Tofu Vegan, Lina Stores, De Kas, NENI, Waterkant, New King) are the founder-reported 'app can't find an obvious menu' set — the regression guard for the language-switch / JS-overlay / menu-one-hop-deeper / Drive-PDF fixes. Five of them are CORE (not extended) on purpose: these are the patterns that keep regressing, so they run on every merge. The sixth, Waterkant, is EXTENDED for the same reason Amai and Drury are absent — its menu is a Google Drive file the restaurant published view-only ('Sorry, the owner hasn't given you permission to download this file'), so no code change can pass it and keeping it core would paint main permanently red. The pipeline now reports it honestly as blocked rather than as 'no menu', which is the part that IS covered by tests. Re-check anytime: `npx tsx scripts/run-pipeline-tests.ts waterkant`. NOTE: two of the 7 sites in docs/debug-failed-dublin-restaurants.md (Amai by Viktor, Drury Buildings) are deliberately NOT listed here — their live auto-discovery still fails (Amai: real menu subpages aren't linked anywhere crawlable, not fixable in code; Drury: a TLS trust-chain gap in Node's bundled CA list, expected to self-resolve — see lib/scraper.ts's fetch-fallback comment). Adding them would mean permanently-failing entries with no code fix to chase; the underlying bugs are instead covered by fixtures in tests/discovery.test.ts and tests/scraper-fetch-fallback.test.ts. Re-check either manually anytime: `npx tsx scripts/run-pipeline-tests.ts amai` / `drury`.
